Converted to a low-power Spike-friendly red creature that keeps the
ember-matters theme via noncombat-damage cost reduction. Renamed to
avoid the theme word while keeping the cinder/ember flavor. ETB ping
keeps the feel of the original burn effect at an appropriate power level
for a 2-mana 1/1.
